test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The manager who was on leave last week (1)/ forgot bringing the files (2)/ that were required for the monthly review (3)/ despite being reminded thrice. (4)

options.text: The manager who was on leave last week (1)
that were required for the monthly review (3)

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in **part 2** of the sentence, involving the choice between a **gerund** (-ing) and an **infinitive** (to + verb) after the verb "forget."
